_comment: Program registry for CollegeDash. Single source of truth for which programs exist, where their data comes from (athletics site platform, TopDrawerSoccer ids, College Scorecard unit id, Wikipedia title, social handles) and the URL templates every collector uses. Read by collect/*, build.py and public/index.html. Add a program by appending to `programs` and running: python collegedash.py onboard <slug>. Optional per-program athletics.campsUrl points the camps collector straight at the program's camp page (skips the nav search and any skipReason); athletics.campsNote is free text for humans. Membership comes from the NCAA Directory (collect/registry_builder.py): onboardedDivisions is the set of divisions the site publishes, and turning a division on is adding it there. A program whose Directory division is not onboarded, or that no Directory list carries, is moved whole to heldPrograms with a `hold` block; refresh, onboard and build read `programs` only, so it is neither collected nor published, and it returns unchanged with the same slug. stagedDivisions is the set of divisions whose programs are in `programs` with onboarded: false, built ahead of onboarding so the list, the slugs and the joins can be reviewed before any collector runs; nothing staged is published or collected, and onboarding a division moves it from stagedDivisions to onboardedDivisions.

season._comment: current = the fall season being played; gradYears = high-school classes tracked for commitments

ncaaDirectory._comment: NCAA Directory sport-sponsorship member lists, one JSON request per division, for the current academic year. The registry's master list: ids.ncaaOrgId is its orgId, and division and conference come from it. No people are in these rows; the Directory's org-detail and contact endpoints list staff and are not used.

tds._comment: TopDrawerSoccer. Team commitments tab is public HTML (no dates). The commitments search lists every girls commit per class, 25 per page, paginated with pageNo (0-based).

soccerwire._comment: SoccerWire player directory is backed by an Elasticsearch proxy; the page's ?filter= param is base64 JSON with facet keys meta.gender.raw, meta.graduation_year.raw, meta.is_committed.raw, meta.college_team.raw.

ncaaRpi._comment: Server-rendered table (class 'sticky') with 'Through Games <date>' in figure.rankings-last-updated. Only the latest week is published, so each weekly snapshot is archived under public/data/rpi/weekly/.

rpiHistory._comment: End-of-season RPI reports 2007-2024 (no 2020) by Chris Thomas, 'RPI for Division I Women's Soccer' (https://sites.google.com/site/rpifordivisioniwomenssoccer/Home). Google Sheets, Teams tab exported as CSV. From 2010 his reports are restated as if the No Overtime rule and the 2024 NCAA RPI formula had been in effect, so they do not show the ratings that stood at the time; 2007-2009 use overtimes and the formula then in effect.

scorecard._comment: US Dept. of Education College Scorecard. Free API key from https://api.data.gov/signup/ ; export SCORECARD_API_KEY. Falls back to DEMO_KEY (30 req/hour) when unset.

climate._comment: NOAA NCEI 1991-2020 U.S. Climate Normals (monthly) via the Access Data Service; no key. Nearest airport (USW, within preferAirportWithinKm) else cooperative (USC) station from the inventory.

athleticsPlatforms._comment: Adapter per site platform. wmt = WMT Digital (Stanford, UCLA): /roster, /roster/season/{year}, /roster/player/{slug}, /schedule/season/{year}, /news. sidearm = Sidearm Sports (USC, Duke, most D1): /roster, /roster/{year}, /roster/{slug}/{id}, /schedule/{year}, news via /rss?path=wsoc plus /archives.
